newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese fishing trawlers block port of Lisbon.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese fishing trawlers block port of Lisbon.

text.p: Portuguese trawlers on Thursday blocked the port of Lisbon, the country's largest, to protest against a partial government ban on weekend fishing, a maritime police spokesman said.
The trawler blockade had initially just hit the fish docks, but the number of boats involved meant that it quickly became impossible for shipping to move in the rest of the port.
"The whole port is affected," the spokesman said.
Fishermen were also picketing the gates of the docks to prevent the transit of lorries carrying fish.
Pedro Franca, president of the Association of Fishing Industry Shipowners, told Reuters earlier that about 100 fishing vessels were involved in the action.

He said the decree banning fishing by Portuguese ships beyond 19 km (12 miles) from the coast for a 24-hour period on weekends was discriminatory, as the Spanish fishing industry faced no such restrictions.
The government says the ban was imposed to conserve stocks.
Franca said he expected the protest to spread to other Portuguese ports on Thursday.
